cases.name: test_allowed_runtime_is_read_only
cases.input: Read own copied probe/interpreter; append to probe and create runtime file
cases.expected: Allowed read succeeds; both writes fail.
cases.method: Actual file I/O inside LPAC; result booleans only. Runtime is the explicitly allowed area.
cases.uncertainty: Only the named local boundary is covered.

cases.name: test_audit_failure_before_start_halts
cases.input: Host audit_hook raises before started INSERT
cases.expected: audit_unavailable, no worker starts; later tasks stay halted.
cases.method: Injected public audit failure plus independent runtime PID snapshots.
cases.uncertainty: Only the named local boundary is covered.

cases.name: test_bank_business_audit_failure_rolls_back
cases.input: Host business executed audit fails after real isolated transfer calculation
cases.expected: audit_unavailable; both simulated balances/transfers roll back; subsequent business stops.
cases.method: Bank audit_hook public fault with real LPAC executor and independent table snapshots.
cases.uncertainty: Only the named local boundary is covered.

cases.name: test_bank_isolation_failure_does_not_change_accounts
cases.input: Isolated execution ending audit fails during yellow transfer confirmation
cases.expected: Bank failed/isolation_failed; balances, transfers and subscription state unchanged; isolation_failed bank audit; no later tool success.
cases.method: Real executor with public finished audit fault; independent business SQLite and public bank audit.
cases.uncertainty: Only the named local boundary is covered.

cases.name: test_bank_three_directions_through_real_executor
cases.input: Normal isolated bill analysis, subscription query/cancel, 10000-cent transfer
cases.expected: All three directions use real compute_tool tasks; fixed fixture amounts and balances correct; historical bills retained.
cases.method: BankService public calls, monitor started counts, independent SQLite balance/history inspection.
cases.uncertainty: Only the named local boundary is covered.

cases.name: test_cancellation_stops_real_worker
cases.input: Cancel event is set during a real sleeping worker
cases.expected: cancelled; at most 100ms detection plus 2s cleanup; no live process remains.
cases.method: Timer/event, host elapsed measurement, receipt and independent OS wait.
cases.uncertainty: Only the named local boundary is covered.

cases.name: test_candidate_parser_and_input_validation
cases.input: parse_candidate valid object followed by duplicates/nonfinite/depth/overlength; unknown task; >65536 JSON input
cases.expected: Valid candidate parsed only as data; invalid_task/invalid_input reject, no fallback parsing.
cases.method: Only public execute and last_receipt; observe started count for rejected-before-launch inputs.
cases.uncertainty: Only the named local boundary is covered.

cases.name: test_child_process_and_breakaway_refused
cases.input: Allowed runtime interpreter invoked by subprocess and native CreateProcess with breakaway
cases.expected: Neither creates a child process.
cases.method: Two real creation APIs; native path bypasses Python-level subprocess wrappers. Job/token receipt still required.
cases.uncertainty: Only the named local boundary is covered.

cases.name: test_cpu_budget
cases.input: Infinite busy loop; CPU limit 0.1 seconds and hard rate 20%
cases.expected: cpu_limit; kernel CPU accounting bounded, job stops before wall timeout.
cases.method: Trusted host CPU and wall counters plus external process wait.
cases.uncertainty: Counter timing may be rounded by the OS; tolerance is 0.3 seconds total user CPU.

cases.name: test_environment_and_inherited_handles
cases.input: Parent exports fake secret env and marks file/socket/process handles inheritable
cases.expected: Secret env absent; all three non-stdio handles unusable in worker; only allowed environment names.
cases.method: Parent verifies its own file read and socket/process handles; worker calls ReadFile/socket/GetProcessId, reports booleans and hash.
cases.uncertainty: Only the named local boundary is covered.

cases.name: test_external_files_and_path_variants
cases.input: Fake .env, synthetic bank/factors files via absolute, case, slash, dot/parent and extended paths
cases.expected: Every external read/write/delete/create fails; host files retain original hashes.
cases.method: Probe performs real OS I/O; host independently checks bytes, existence and newly created paths.
cases.uncertainty: Only the named local boundary is covered.

cases.name: test_finished_audit_failure_and_recovery
cases.input: Host hook raises on finished INSERT after a real successful worker
cases.expected: Result withheld, audit_unavailable and halted; reopening appends abandoned without changing old rows.
cases.method: Real LPAC execution, failing audit commit, external process exit, independent monitor reopen.
cases.uncertainty: Only the named local boundary is covered.

cases.name: test_identity_and_host_receipt_agree

cases.expected: LPAC and AppContainer true, zero capabilities, low integrity; host metadata agrees and limits enforced.

cases.uncertainty: Only the named local boundary is covered.

cases.name: test_limits_cannot_be_weakened
cases.input: Defaults expanded, unknown limits key, process_count=2 and below-minimum limits
cases.expected: Each invalid limit is rejected without worker creation.
cases.method: Only frozen public limits are used; independently compare process images.
cases.uncertainty: Only the named local boundary is covered.

cases.name: test_memory_budget
cases.input: Repeated 1MiB allocations; memory budget 32MiB
cases.expected: No success; memory_limit or honest nonzero_exit; peak bounded by kernel.
cases.method: Real allocation pressure; trusted peak Job memory, no OOM self-report accepted.
cases.uncertainty: Only the named local boundary is covered.

cases.name: test_missing_configuration_refuses
cases.input: Missing runtime config
cases.expected: Constructor rejects and starts no ordinary fallback worker.
cases.method: Empty independent directory; compare OS runtime process set before/after.
cases.uncertainty: Only the named local boundary is covered.

cases.name: test_monitor_append_only_and_task_lifecycle
cases.input: Two tasks plus attempted SQLite UPDATE/DELETE of monitoring audit
cases.expected: started/finished persisted per task; old rows unchanged; both mutations rejected.
cases.method: Read public isolation_audit table with sqlite3; direct mutation attempts exercise append-only triggers.
cases.uncertainty: Only the named local boundary is covered.

cases.name: test_monitor_database_is_not_worker_readable

cases.expected: LPAC cannot read host monitoring SQLite.

cases.expected: Exclusive owner rejects second monitor; close releases lock.

cases.uncertainty: Only the named local boundary is covered.

cases.name: test_nonzero_exit_does_not_leak_stderr
cases.input: Worker exits 7 with fake secret written to stderr
cases.expected: nonzero_exit, data withheld, fake secret absent from receipt and monitor.
cases.method: Real abnormal exit and serialized safety scans; fake secret body never printed.
cases.uncertainty: Only the named local boundary is covered.

cases.name: test_parent_exit_kills_job_and_recovers
cases.input: Kill an ordinary host while its real isolated worker sleeps
cases.expected: Worker exits after host death; monitor lock releases and new owner appends abandoned.
cases.method: Dedicated child host, Toolhelp/image-path worker discovery, OS terminate/wait, public monitor recovery.
cases.uncertainty: Dedicated runtime must not be shared with another concurrent run during this case.

cases.name: test_red_transfer_stays_refused
